data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Lissie is derived from the name Elissaios, meaning 'God heals' or 'Liberator'. It is also linked to the Greek word 'lisso', meaning 'free'.

in_hebrew.name: ליסי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ליסי נגזר מהמילה העברית 'אליס' שפירושה 'אלוהים הוא השוע שלי'. השם מופיע בשורשים עבריים וקשור לנושא ההצלה והישועה. השימוש בשם זה נמשך לאורך הדורות ומופיע בקרב קהילות יהודיות ונוצריות כאחד.

in_greek.name: Λίσση
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Λίσση προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὴν ἑβραϊκὴ λέξη 'אליס' ποὺ σημαίνει 'Θεός εἰς ἡ σωτηρία μου'. Στὴν Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόλο ποὺ δὲν ἀναφέρεται ἕνα συγκεκριμένο πρόσωπο μὲ αὐτὸ τὸ ὄνομα, ἡ ἔννοια τῆς σωτηρίας εἶναι θεμελιώδης στὸ χριστιανικὸ μήνυμα. Ἡ χρήση τοῦ ὀνόματος Λίσση ἦταν συνηθισμένη στὴν ἀρχαία Εκκλησία.

in_latin.name: Lissie
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Lissie derivatur a voce hebrea 'אליס', quae significat 'Deus est salus mea'. In Scripturis Sacris, huiusmodi nomina quae salutem et auxilium Dei exprimunt, usitata sunt. In primitiva Ecclesia Christiana, appellatio Lissie ad thema redemptionis et protectionis divina pertinebat.

in_english.name: Lissie
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lissie originates from the Hebrew word 'אליס' (Alis), meaning 'God is my salvation'. Historically, names with similar roots were used in Jewish and early Christian communities to express devotion and trust in God.

It was a name given to children born into Christian families as a reminder of God's blessings and miracles. Today, the name Lissie is used in many English-speaking countries and is often given to babies as a symbol of hope, healing, and freedom.

It is believed that the name represents the healing power of God and a reminder of the liberation and freedom that comes from a life rooted in faith.
